interactions.sentence: [color=#ffffff][b]Lan:[/b][/color] [b]One sanitary pad[/b], please. From the purple An Tam pack.

response_choices: One pad. Is something wrong, Lan?

interactions.sentence: [color=#ffffff][b]Lan:[/b][/color] I heard Hanh lift her gate last night during their earlier dispute. Then a man said, "You cannot cross me out." I thought it was Binh. I saw him walking past my shop alive this morning.
